_comment: Purpose: user-requested patron tiers. Signup/payment links and billing cadence await organiser confirmation. No automatic subscriptions, charges or benefit fulfilment are implemented.
intro: Support the OAC family and the local artists who help bring it to life.
billing: Billing period and signup details to be confirmed.

tiers.name: Supporter
benefits: Monthly digital art or wallpaper drop from OAC artists

tiers.name: Core
benefits: 50% ticket discount on normal events and 15% on big events
A vote on upcoming watch parties and events
Small monthly physical item, such as a sticker or postcard

tiers.name: Guild
benefits: Monthly goodie pack with an art print or merch from a local artist
Free entry to one event per quarter

note: No Guild slot limit is currently set. Payment links, billing period, delivery arrangements and patron terms will be confirmed before signup opens. The team classifies normal and big events.
